s.t:
In this position you will serve as a first line supervisor over a team of Program Managers who are engaged in managing critical program segments for which the scope and effect of the work have an Office of Field Operations-wide impact.

You will oversee a variety of law enforcement programs, to include enforcement operations for drug interdiction and seized narcotics accountability. This position starts at a salary of $143,913.00 (GS-14, Step 1) to $187,093.00 (GS-14, Step 10).

Typical duties include: Planning, organizing, coordinating, controlling, and evaluating the activities of an organization(s) Overseeing the overall planning, direction, and timely execution of a program or several program segments, each of which is managed through separate subordinate organizational units Leading complex projects, often cutting across organizational/activity lines, defining critical quality factors and process improvements Assuring implementation by subordinate organizations and operating units of the goals and objectives of a CBP-wide program Determining goals and objectives that need additional emphasis; developing measures that evaluate performance; making recommendations for program improvement; and managing all resources as corporate assets GS Salary: Visit this link to view the locality pay tables by geographic area.

If you do not see your geographic area listed, select the "Rest of United States" pay table. Some positions fall under a special pay rate depending on the series, grade level and location of the position. Please visit this link to view special pay rate charts.
Experience: You qualify for the GS-14 grade level if you possess 1 year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade level, performing duties such as: Planning, directing, and evaluating major program segments that include diverse professional, technical, and administrative activities, with impact across a headquarters-level office or nationwide program, including development and execution of multi-year work plans and goals.

Leading complex, cross-organizational projects as a subject matter expert, including applying analytical methodologies (such as statistical tools, mathematical techniques, and process mapping) to improve service delivery, reduce costs, increase quality, and develop and justify business cases.

Providing technical direction in project management, team building, facilitation, process improvement analysis, and the methodology required to develop and substantiate a business case for the selected project.

Overseeing law enforcement-related programs such as inspection, intelligence analysis, drug interdiction, and seized property accountability, including ensuring enforcement of applicable laws and policies, overseeing enforcement actions, and ensuring proper custody, preservation, and disposition of contraband and seized property.

Managing organizational change and resources, including approving allocation and distribution of funds, implementing internal controls in accordance with the Federal Managers' Integrity Act, identifying and resolving issues where no policy exists, and coordinating with senior officials within and outside the agency to address complex, cross-cutting program issues.

NOTE: Your resume must explicitly indicate how you meet this requirement, otherwise you will be found ineligible. Please see the "Required Documents" section below for additional resume requirements.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

You must: Meet all qualification requirements, including education if applicable to this position, subject to verification at any stage of the application process; and Meet all applicable Time in Grade requirements (current federal employees must have served 52 weeks at the next lower grade or equivalent grade band in the federal service) by 08/12/2026.

The Office of Personnel Management (OPM) must authorize employment offers made to current or former political appointees.

If you are currently, or have been within the last 5 years, a political Schedule A, Schedule C, Non-career SES or Presidential Appointee employee in the Executive Branch, you must disclose this information to the Human Resources Office. Background Investigation: U.S.

Customs and Border Protection (CBP) is a federal law enforcement agency that requires all applicants to undergo a thorough background investigation prior to employment in order to promote the agency's core values of vigilance, service to country, and integrity.

During the screening and/or background investigation process, you will be asked questions regarding any felony criminal convictions or current felony charges, the use of illegal drugs (e.g., marijuana, cocaine, heroin, LSD, methamphetamines, ecstasy), and the use of non-prescribed controlled substances including any experimentation, possession, sale, receipt, manufacture, cultivation, production, transfer, shipping, trafficking, or distribution of controlled substances.

For additional information on the preemployment process, review the following link: Applicant Resources | CBP Careers Residency: There is a residency requirement for all applicants not currently employed by CBP.

Individuals are required to have physically resided in the United States or its protectorates (as declared under international law) for at least three of the last five years.

If you do not meet the residency requirement and you have been physically located in a foreign location for more than two of the last five years, you may request an exception to determine if you are eligible for a residency waiver by meeting one or more of the following conditions: Working for the U.S.

Government as a federal civilian or as a member of the military A dependent who was authorized to accompany a federal civilian or member of the military who was working for the U.S. government Participation in a study abroad program sponsored by a U.S. affiliated college or university Working as a contractor, intern, consultant or volunteer supporting the U.S. government Probationary Period: All employees new to the federal government must serve a one year probationary period during the first year of his/her initial permanent federal appointment to determine fitness for continued employment.

Current and former federal employees may be required to serve or complete a probationary period. Agency Career Transition Assistance Program (CTAP) Eligibles: If you have never worked for the federal government, you are not CTAP eligible. View information about CTAP eligibility on OPM's Career Transition Resources website.

Company Description
About M3: A Japanese global leader in the provision of ground-breaking and innovative technological and research solutions to the healthcare industry.

The M3 Group operates in the US, Asia, and Europe with over 5.8 million physician members globally via its physician websites which include mdlinx.com, m3.com, research.m3.com, Doctors.net.uk, medigate.net, and medlive.cn.

M3 Inc. is a publicly traded company on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (jp:2413, NIKKEI 225) with subsidiaries in major markets including the US, UK, Japan, South Korea, and China, and in 2020 was ranked in Forbes’ Global 2000 list. The M3 Group provides services to healthcare and the life science industry.

In addition to market research, these services include medical education, ethical drug promotion, clinical development, job recruitment, and clinic appointment services. M3 has offices in Japan, UK, France, Germany, Brazil, Sweden, China, USA, and South Korea, as well as India.

This role is part of MED PLANET , a Lyon based fieldwork agency and a wholly owned subsidiary of M3 Inc. MED PLANET is a leading provider of data-collection services for the pharmaceutical and healthcare industry. We specialize in conducting both qualitative and quantitative market research in France. MED PLANET provides high quality translations and transcription for healthcare fieldwork projects for the M3MR group.
Job Description
As a Project Manager in our translations department, you will be responsible for managing several language-related projects simultaneously, ensuring that they are delivered on time, meeting quality expectations and within scope.

With effective written and verbal communication, you will help ensure the teams are clear on the scope and expectations of clients and that the clients are kept fully informed as to the progress and status of their projects.

You will work closely with our project management team, language professionals, to seek guidance when required and ensure project success.
Support in planning, execution, and monitoring several language-related projects simultaneously using project management tools to ensure that projects are delivered on time and within scope.
Support in maintaining and creating project schedules, and timelines ensuring that they are in line with SLAs and achievable and that they reflect the clients' requirements and expectations.
Monitor project progress on progress, challenges and/or successes throughout the project
Support in maintaining project documentation, including project plans, reports, and communications, using document management software such as SharePoint, etc., to ensure that we have accurate records of our projects.
Prepare quotes and invoices using project management software and accounting software to ensure that we generate revenue and meet our business goals.
Ensure adherence to company standards and procedures in project management to maintain our reputation for delivering high-quality language services.
Identify errors and areas of improvement and report when needed to the relevant stakeholders.
Support during meetings, documenting these when required and distributing minutes/actions to the team.

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as business, management, or language studies.
2 or more years of experience in managing localisation projects.
Essential fluency in English. an additional language would be advantageous.
Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and work under pressure to meet our clients' needs and achieve our business objectives.
Additional Information
Note: this will be an independent contractor position

Wir suchen eine:n Projekmanager:in für unser Projektmanagement Team an unserem Standort in Heidelberg. Werde Teil unseres Teams und baue mit uns das größte KI-gestützte FinTech für das Gesundheitswesen auf!

s.h: Was dich in der Rolle als Projektmanager:in erwartet
s.t:
Du begleitest Arztpraxen vom ersten Tag an - von der technischen Einrichtung über die Schulung des Praxisteams bis zur aktiven Betreuung in den ersten Wochen nach dem Go-live. Dabei übernimmst du echte Verantwortung: Du managst deine Projekte eigenständig, bist erste Ansprechperson für deine Kunden und sorgst dafür, dass der Wechsel zu Nelly reibungslos klappt. Kein Tag ist wie der andere – du bist nah an den Menschen, nah am Produkt und siehst direkt, was deine Arbeit bewirkt.
Über Nelly
Wir bauen das AI-Driven Financial Operating System für das europäische Gesundheitswesen und lösen so die größten Herausforderungen für Patient:innen und Praxen. Damit schaffen wir, was keine Bank oder Softwareplattform bewältigen kann.

Unsere All-In-One Plattform verwandelt chaotische administrative Prozesse in intelligente, automatisierte Arbeitsabläufe, von der Patientenbetreuung über die Abrechnung bis hin zu Zahlungen der nächsten Generation. Denn wir sind davon überzeugt: Das Gesundheitswesen sollte weniger mit Papierkram und mehr mit Menschen zu tun haben.
Warum? Europa ist mit einem massiven Mangel an medizinischen Fachkräften konfrontiert. Wenn wir die Arbeitsweise von Praxen nicht überdenken, wird das System nicht mithalten können. Mit unserer Series B Finanzierung in Höhe von über 50 Millionen Euro von Weltklasse-Investoren setzen wir unsere Vision in die Tat um.
Was dich erwartet: Wir arbeiten mit dem besten Team und geben gemeinsam jeden Tag alles. Wir setzen auf Talent Density, weil außergewöhnliche Menschen alle um sie herum besser machen. Bei Nelly bewegen wir uns schnell und erwarten, dass alle mithalten. Stillstand ist keine Option, deshalb investieren wir stark in Weiterentwicklung.

KI ist bei uns kein Nice-to-have. Wir erwarten, dass du sie täglich nutzt und geben dir alle Möglichkeiten, dies zu tun. Du bekommst Vertrauen und Verantwortung, dafür erwarten wir, dass du Dinge ansprichst, auch wenn es unbequem ist.

Du bist zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Produkt, Vertrieb und Technik und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden mit einem perfekten Start in die Zusammenarbeit mit Nelly durchstarten.
Du führst Implementierungsprojekte von A bis Z: von der technischen Integration über den Produktaufbau bis zur Schulung der Praxisteams (vor Ort & online) und der aktiven Nachbetreuung in der Hypercare-Phase (~30 Tage).
Du erkennst Risiken und Probleme im Projektverlauf frühzeitig, sprichst sie aktiv an und bringst eigene Lösungsideen ein.
Du planst, koordinierst und priorisierst deine Aufgaben eigenständig und sorgst so für einen reibungslosen Projektverlauf – auch wenn du mehrere Projekte parallel betreust.

Erste Erfahrung im Projektmanagement oder in der Kundenbetreuung – und echte Lust, noch mehr Verantwortung zu übernehmen.
Proaktivität ist für dich selbstverständlich: du denkst mit, fragst nach und gehst Herausforderungen lösungsorientiert an.
Starke Kommunikation in Wort und Schrift – ob du 5 oder 40 Personen schulst, du trittst sicher und überzeugend auf.

Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein – insbesondere im Umgang mit sensiblen Kunden-, Zahlungs- und Patientendaten.

## Senior Relationship Manager ##
Our client, a distinguished Swiss private bank is renowned for combining long-standing private banking tradition with modern, innovative wealth management. Serving an international base of high-net-worth individuals and institutional clients.

You will join a culture where senior bankers are given the platform, tools, and autonomy to grow their own portfolios, backed by first-class investment advisory, risk, and compliance teams.

Many of their top performers have progressed into strategic leadership roles after successfully building and expanding HNW books, reflecting a genuine commitment to professional growth and long-term career development.

* Prestigious Swiss private banking platform: Work in a high-calibre environment serving sophisticated HNW and institutional clients with wealth management and advisory solutions.
* Ownership and impact: Take direct responsibility for growing your own client portfolio, increasing assets under management, and representing the bank at key industry events and networking forums.
* Holistic support and development: Collaborate closely with in-house investment, risk, and compliance specialists, deepening your technical expertise while further developing your multilingual, commercial, and leadership skills.

* Develop and grow a HNW client portfolio: Acquire, advise, and retain high-net-worth and institutional clients, increasing assets under management while ensuring solutions are fully aligned with client objectives and the bank-s long-term strategy.
* Deliver tailored, sophisticated solutions: Work closely with investment advisory, risk management, and compliance teams to design and implement holistic wealth management strategies across asset classes, reflecting both Swiss and international regulatory requirements.
* Act as a strategic ambassador: Represent the bank at industry events, conferences, and networking forums, leveraging your market insight and relationship-building skills to enhance the bank-s market presence and support its growth ambitions.

* Proven private banking track record: Tertiary degree in finance, economics, business administration, or a related field, combined with 5-7+ years- experience in relationship management and a successful history of managing HNW client portfolios in private banking or wealth management-positioning you to quickly make an impact.
* Deep technical and regulatory expertise: Extensive knowledge of financial products, asset classes, and investment strategies, alongside strong familiarity with Swiss and international banking regulations, enabling you to provide informed, compliant, and value-adding advice.
* Exceptional relationship and development skills: Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal abilities, with fluency in English and ideally German, French, or Italian, empowering you to collaborate internally, expand your client base, and represent the bank confidently in the market.

Mindpeak is building cutting-edge AI technology to transform cancer diagnostics for the better. Our AI-powered software is already in clinical use across more than 25 countries, helping pathologists assess tumour tissue faster, more accurately, and more consistently. Every year, tens of thousands of cancer patients already benefit from quicker and more accurate diagnoses enabled by our technology.
Our mission is to scale this impact worldwide and help make personalised, effective cancer treatment accessible to every patient no matter where they are. By combining state-of-the-art AI with real-world clinical impact, we’re working toward a future where every cancer patient gets the best possible diagnosis and, ultimately, the best possible care.

Every new laboratory that implements our AI for routine diagnostics is a project with a lot of moving parts. The software is connected to the laboratory's image management and information systems, our AI is validated on their cases, pathologists are trained, and the requirements of their market and accreditors are met.

Each of these projects brings together laboratory directors, pathologists and IT teams on the customer side, scanner and software partners, and our product, ML, engineering and quality teams internally.
As Clinical Implementation Manager you lead those projects. You own the plan, direct the specialists who do the technical work, and carry the go-live date. Once a laboratory is live you stay with them as their main contact, owning support and our long-term success with the partner. This is not a sales role and you do not carry a sales target.
What you'll own
Onboarding projects
Build and own the project plan for each new laboratory, from kickoff to go-live, with dependencies and dates kept current.
Direct the work across our product, ML, engineering and quality teams and the customer's staff.
Accompany the validations customers run as part of onboarding. The laboratory's medical director designs the study; you make sure the technical setup is correctly installed and working, that our teams deliver what the validation depends on, and that the customer has everything they need to complete it.
Carry the committed go-live date, and raise risks early with options rather than after a slip.
Customer success after go-live
Act as the customer's main point of contact once live, monitoring usage and engagement and reaching out proactively.
Own incoming support requests: resolve what you can, coordinate product and engineering on the rest, and close the loop with the customer.
Bring what you learn from customers into product planning, and flag potential expansion opportunities to Sales where relevant.Bring what you learn from customers into product planning.
You do not carry a sales target. But flagging expansion opportunities to Sales is part of your responsibility.
How you'll start
You will take on real customer onboarding projects from the start and lead them yourself, with close support from the team and from your manager in the beginning. As you build familiarity with our products and our customers, you move into running them independently.
Your Profile
A degree in biology, molecular biology, biomedical sciences, medicine, or a related field.
3+ years leading projects with external customers — clinical or diagnostic implementation, digital pathology, medical device or laboratory rollout, health IT deployment, or comparable delivery work.
Proven ability to build a realistic project plan and drive it to a date, updating it responsibly and transparently as things change.
Proven ability to direct people inside and outside the company.
Technically confident: able to discuss interfaces, integrations and data credibly with ML engineers and IT staff, instruct them clearly, and translate between them and the customer.
Able to hold a room with a laboratory director, a pathologist and an IT lead, and keep all three aligned.
Full professional proficiency in English. German is not required.
Based in Hamburg, or willing to relocate, and working on-site with the team.
Willing to travel to customer sites internationally — occasional trips, typically a few times a year, focus on US customers.
Comfortable with the occasional late-afternoon or early-evening call to overlap with customers in other time zones.

Experience in pathology, diagnostics or laboratory environments, or a background in the natural sciences.
If you have not worked in pathology: evidence that you have become competent in an unfamiliar technical domain before.
Experience working within a quality management system, or delivering software into a regulated clinical setting.
Commercial instinct.

In short
We're looking for a Senior Project Manager to join our PM team and lead mobile and web projects for IoT, wearables, and connected devices. You'll be the single point of contact for our US-based clients and the person holding a cross-functional team together day to day. This is a permanent role: B2B contract, monthly salary, full benefits, and a team that has been doing this since 2008.
Why intent ?
We've been designing and co-creating connected devices since 2008. Wearables, smart audio, health-tech hardware for clients like Oura and BOSE, backed by investors like a16z and Founders Fund. We're 60+ people, fully remote, and AI-native since before LinkedIn influencers discovered the term. Our PMs don't manage Jira tickets, they own projects: scoping, staffing, client conversations, trade-offs, and the day-to-day rhythm that makes a connected product actually ship.
Who this role is NOT for
If you like running stand-ups by the book, sending status updates, and waiting for someone else to make the hard calls, we're probably not your people. We look for PMs who ask "why" before "how", challenge specs that don't add up, and walk into a room full of ambiguity ready to create structure.

We're AI-native and we expect you to treat AI as a daily multiplier, not a gimmick. What we expect: ownership of your project end to end, straight talk with clients and the team, and the kind of curiosity that makes you actually care about what the device does, not just whether the sprint closes on time.

Be the single point of contact for our US-based clients: great communicator, diplomat, and when needed, negotiator
Manage web and mobile projects end to end: discovery, scoping, launch, and what comes after
Lead a cross-functional squad of designers, developers, QA, and other PMs
Run Scrum ceremonies, plan sprints, manage backlogs, timelines, budgets, and project health
Co-create product vision with clients: features, MVP strategy, the smartest way to deliver value
Lead staffing and resource planning with other chapters
Push for better ways of working, inside your squad and across the company
Use AI tools as part of your daily workflow, not as a party trick
How we work
Fully remote. We have a pet-friendly office in Warsaw and a coworking space in Gdansk if walls and coffee machines motivate you, but nobody will ask why you're not there. Working hours are flexible: most of the team operates between 10:00 and 18:00 CET, and that's when most meetings happen.

Evening calls with US-based clients (typically 16:00-20:00 CET, around 2-3 per week) are a normal part of the PM role here, always planned ahead. You'll be part of the PM chapter for knowledge-sharing, and at the same time leading your own project squad day to day.
What you'll get

s.h: 17,000-23,000 PLN/month net B2B, depending on your experience
s.t:
26 days of paid leave
10 days of paid sick leave
Saltus medical care
Self-development budget (2,000 PLN or 500 USD/year)

s.h: Truly flexible hours: you organize your day
s.t:
Fully remote, with pet-friendly Warsaw office + Gdansk cowork if you want them
All necessary equipment provided
Internal knowledge-sharing: tech talks, team sessions, library and conference budgets
Your first months
We aim to give you space to ramp up before owning a full project, but this is a real company with real deadlines: if a squad needs you sooner, we'll make sure you have the support to hit the ground running. You'll get paired with a buddy, meet the team, and start with real tasks while being guided by your team and leadership.

Monthly HR check-ins, real feedback after month two, and a proper review after month three: if things feel great on both sides, you're officially part of the crew. No one waits three months to tell you something isn't working: if it's great, you'll know; if something needs adjusting, you'll hear about it while there's still time to adjust.
Recruitment process
The entire process is in English. All interviews are recorded for internal evaluation purposes.
Application with a few screening questions
HR call, ~45 min, casual
Short take-home task (~60 min)
Technical meeting, ~90 min, with the Head of PM and COO
Final feedback within a few days
Once we're in touch, you'll hear from us fast. We don't ghost and we don't drag.
One more thing
intent is an equal opportunity employer. We care about what you can do, not where you come from. Send us your CV and a few words about why this caught your eye. Bonus points if you share a project you led that you're proud of, ideally one where the delivery was harder than the spec suggested.

Solid Agile foundations, especially Scrum
Ability to step into a Scrum Master or Product Owner role if the project needs it
Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset

Warum diese Rolle
Lucid Labs ist eine spezialisierte Beratung für den deutschen Mittelstand. Wir automatisieren operative Entscheidungen, mit angewandter KI und einer eigenen Plattform, die bei Kunden produktiv läuft. Unsere Pipeline wächst schneller als unser Team. Wir suchen jemanden, der unsere Kundenprojekte übernimmt und in den nächsten zwölf Monaten in die volle Verantwortung für eigene Kunden hineinwächst.
Dabei sind wir besonders stolz auf unsere Geschwindigkeit. Von der Idee bis zum Piloten beim Kunden dauert es bei uns rund eine Woche. Den Hebel, den du im Workshop identifizierst, testet der Kunde nächste Woche als Prototyp. Direkt mit der Geschäftsführung und ohne Layer dazwischen.
Der eigentliche Grund für diese Rolle ist aber ein anderer: Hier wirst du AI-native. Du lernst, KI-Lösungen nicht nur theoretisch zu empfehlen und auf Folien aufzuzeigen, sondern selbst zu bauen, und berätst Unternehmen genau dabei. Das ist der Skill, der in den nächsten Jahren entscheidet, welche Berater gefragt sind. Und kaum ein Ort bringt ihn dir schneller bei als ein Team, das jede Woche selbst baut, was es berät.
Wenn du heute Rollouts, Implementierungen oder Digitalisierungsprojekte betreust und dabei mehr verwaltest als gestaltest: Genau dafür ist diese Rolle gedacht.
Aufgaben
Du übernimmst Kundenprojekte: Discovery, Workshops, laufende Implementierung. In den ersten Wochen gemeinsam mit jemandem, der das schon kann, danach allein. Mehrere Kunden parallel, mit deutlich mehr Tiefe pro Kunde als im klassischen Beratungsgeschäft. Du berichtest direkt an den Gründer und arbeitest eng mit unserem Engineering-Team. Das heißt Entscheidungswege von Minuten, nicht von Wochen.
70 % Kundenarbeit: Du bist Ansprechperson für deine Projekte, meist direkt für die Geschäftsführung unserer Kunden. Workshops vorbereiten und leiten, wöchentliche Calls, Demos, Scoping, Anforderungen ins Engineering übersetzen. Dein Maßstab: Deine Kunden arbeiten nach wenigen Wochen messbar anders.
20 % Prototyping: Erste Prototypen baust du selbst, mit modernen AI-Tools und ohne Programmierung. Das ist die Folie, die funktioniert. Wie das geht, lernst du bei uns — und es ist der Teil der Rolle, in dem du am schnellsten wächst.
10 % Pre-Sales & Scoping: Workshops sind bei uns auch ein Sales-Tool. Du bereitest Opportunities mit vor, bist in Angebotsgesprächen dabei und übernimmst mit der Zeit die Folgepotenziale bei deinen eigenen Bestandskunden.
Und weil wir in der Aufbau-Phase sind: Was du in deinen Projekten an Vorlagen, Checklisten und Abläufen entwickelst, wird zum Standard, nach dem das Delivery-Team danach arbeitet.
Deine ersten Monate
In den ersten 6–8 Wochen läufst du in laufenden Projekten mit, übernimmst schrittweise einzelne Workshops und Calls und lernst unsere Tools - nicht in einer Schulung, sondern an echten Kunden, mit jemandem daneben. Nach etwa drei Monaten führst du 2–3 Kundenprojekte selbst, mit einem Sparringspartner im Rücken.

Nach sechs Monaten trägst du deine Kunden allein und kannst Dinge, die du am Anfang nicht konntest: einen Prozess auseinandernehmen, einen Prototyp bauen, eine Geschäftsführerin durch eine Entscheidung führen.

Remote mit Berlin als Basis. Du arbeitest, wo du willst. Mittwochs treffen wir uns als Team im EDGE Coworking am Hauptbahnhof. Wer weiter weg wohnt, kommt nach Absprache seltener, und wer gern im Office arbeitet, kann jederzeit häufiger da sein.
Wer wir sind
Lucid Labs ist ein AI-first Studio, gegründet von Marek Janetzke. Wir arbeiten selbst so, wie wir beraten: mit Cursor, Claude und den jeweils besten Tools im Alltag. Unsere Kultur: Ownership statt Micromanagement. Lieber in zwei Wochen eine smarte Wette machen und daraus lernen, als drei Monate etwas polieren, das niemand validiert hat. Included Health is looking for a Senior Recruiting Program Manager to lead a portfolio of recruiting programs and operational improvements. This role will focus on several key areas including internal mobility, talent brand, and process improvement. They will also manage the contingent workforce programs. Furthermore, the role will support change management for major recruiting initiatives, including the ATS transition.
This is a strategic program-owner role for someone who can bring structure to ambiguous problems, connect business goals to execution, and drive measurable outcomes across multiple teams. The successful candidate will be a trusted advisor to Talent Acquisition management and other partners. They will influence others without direct authority, help shift programs from planning to adoption, and will ensure continuous improvement.

Recruiting Program Portfolio
Own recruiting programs from planning through execution, measurement, and iteration.
Build clear program plans, milestones, stakeholder maps, risks, decisions, communications, and success measures.
Lead the operational development of an internal mobility program.
Support talent-brand programs that strengthen Included Health ’s employer brand proposition, diversify sources of hire, and improve the candidate experience.
Use data and stakeholder feedback to assess progress, identify risks, and recommend action.
Process Improvement
Identify friction across the recruiting lifecycle and design simpler, more consistent ways of working.
Improve processes through standardization, documentation, automation opportunities, and clear ownership.
Incorporate AI and technology into recruiting processes to automate manual work, improve efficiency, and scale operations.
Use data and feedback to evaluate whether process changes are improving efficiency, quality, and experience.
Build repeatable playbooks and operating practices that can scale across Talent Acquisition.
Change Management and Adoption
Lead change-management efforts for major recruiting initiatives, including the ATS transition.
Create strategies to get stakeholders involved. Prepare communications, training materials, enablement materials, and plans for adoption.

Build feedback loops, identify resistance or readiness risks, and adjust the change approach as needed.
Measure adoption and reinforce new ways of working after launch.

Create clear expectations for contingent worker onboarding, performance, reporting, issue resolution, escalation, and offboarding.
Use data to evaluate partner performance, utilization, cost, quality, and responsiveness.
Partner with Talent Acquisition, HR, Finance, Legal, and business leaders to improve governance and decision-making.
Suggest useful ways to balance internal recruiting and external options. This includes vendors, agencies, contractors, and automation.
Cross-Functional Management
Serve as a strategic partner to Talent Acquisition leaders and a trusted advisor to recruiters, hiring managers, HR Operations, HR Systems, IT, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and vendors.
Facilitate working sessions and decision forums that progress complex work forward.
Influence without formal authority and create accountability across teams with different priorities.
Communicate clearly with executive, technical, operational, and frontline audiences.
Build alignment, surface risks early, and keep stakeholders focused on measurable outcomes.

7+ years of experience in recruiting operations, talent programs or a related field.
Demonstrated experience owning complex, cross-functional programs from strategy through execution, adoption, and measurement.
Experience leading change-management efforts for a major process, program, or technology transition.
Deep knowledge of recruiting processes, stakeholder needs, and the candidate, manager, and recruiter experience.
Demonstrated ability to operate in ambiguity, define direction, and make progress with incomplete information.
Proficient data fluency, including the ability to interpret metrics, identify trends, evaluate tradeoffs, and make evidence-based recommendations.

Strong project and program-management skills, including planning, governance, risk management, prioritization, and executive communication.

Strong judgment, organization, follow-through, and comfort balancing strategic priorities with operational detail.

initiative

As a subordinate supervisor, this position reports to the designated selecting official for the new hire ATCs in the ATO in the ATO Technical Onboarding Team (AJG-P23). This position is designated as the Supervisor of new hire ATC trainees.

Although the employees (new hire ATCs in the ATO) are located in another organization within ATO, AJG onboards and supervises the trainees to training at the Academy.

This position serves the supervisory function for this large group of Academy trainees and oversees their progress, approves travel, time and attendance, administers conduct and discipline, terminates the trainee when needed (ie. Training failure, suitability issue, conduct issue).

The Academy New Hire Program Manager applies experience and expert knowledge of program and/or project management fundamentals to manage the day-to-day administrative activities involving new student hires to the Air Traffic Control Academy by serving as the supervisor for all Air Traffic Control Specialist (ATCS) Academy students.

Plans and accomplishes highly complex and challenging projects/programs and other work activities under the minimal direction of the manager. Applies knowledge of Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) hiring policies and objectives to facilitate and guide the facility placement program for new hire ATCS who successfully complete academy training.

This work directly affects the ATO's ability to meet ATCS hiring goals to ensure the safe and efficient operation of the National Airspace System.

Managerial duties typically affect employees and managers in more than one organizational unit/project/program, and include planning; communicating the organization's vision and objectives; setting priorities; assigning tasks and responsibilities; monitoring and evaluating performance; coaching and developing employee capabilities; approving leave; and taking, recommending or approving corrective/disciplinary actions, as appropriate.

Provides oversight for the new hire ATCS Academy students' Academy attendance and coordinates with offices located at the Mike Monroney Aeronautical Center (MMAC) and Headquarters regarding class schedules, rosters, training class dates, etc.

Approves new student hire time and attendance, conducts administrative inquiries, and administers disciplinary actions. Certifies GI Bill Training Certificates and approves travel authorizations and vouchers. Oversees recording in eLMS of completed training courses into student records.

Oversees the establishment of FAA network accounts and email addresses for new hire students. Applies knowledge of EEO regulations and participates in EEO investigations as required. Acts a principal specialist in developing new and innovative approaches, methodologies, and/or techniques to improve program operations.

Coordinates ATCS new hire pipeline of applicants available for onboarding at the FAA Academy, which frequently requires the development of new and innovative approaches. Analyzes and evaluates the effectiveness of the new hire program. Develops and recommends approaches to address current and anticipated problems and issues.

Works with senior management to identify and resolve problems. Creates and maintains project plans and leads ad hoc team meetings to track progress of ATCS Academy Students. Monitors and manages program tasks to assess whether hiring goals are being met.

Identifies key parameters to track data, maintain new student database, analyze data, and to report progress status to management. Develops evaluation methods to assess program strengths and identify areas for improvement.

The Program Manager applies skill using desktop and automated programs such as Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Power Point, Word, Visio, and other automated software. Analyzes and edits material/data for presentations to senior management. Prepares responses to Congressional inquiries and other highly visible ad hoc projects as required.
To qualify for this position, you must demonstrate in your application that you possess at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to the FV-I, FG/GS-13 level.

This experience is typically related to the line of work of the position to be filled and which has equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities to successfully perform the duties of the position.

To be creditable, specialized experience must have been at least equivalent to the next lower level in the normal line of progression for the occupation in the organization.

Specialized Experience is defined as: -Experience analyzing and evaluating the effectiveness of new programs AND -Experience creating and maintaining project plans, leading ad hoc team meetings to track progress of employees/trainees and monitoring/managing program tasks to assess whether hiring goals are being met.
